name: Anonymous Shopify shipping-discount app
description: A Shopify app for shipping discounts. The TrustMRR listing does not name it. One person, bootstrapped. The listed price is $9.90 a month. Australia.

mentions.evidence: $7,762 L30, updated 12 November 2026. All-time $63,927. Founded January 2024. The listing says about 1,200 people use it. The $9.90 price is the listing, not the Shopify total. Twelve times the last 30 days is about $93,000. That is arithmetic, not a figure they published.
mentions.indieAngle: The app store still has room for one small checkout rule. Shipping, a trade price, a local parcel locker.

whyItPrints: One job at checkout, a flat fee, no story around it.
whyThisMatters: Checkout has a hundred small rules, and shipping discounts are one of them. This listing is a Shopify app for that rule, and the listing does not give the product a name or a site. One person, bootstrapped, Australia, a flat price of nine dollars and ninety cents a month. Shopify-verified means the listing is connected to Shopify. I do not log in and re-check the number. The synced reading on 12 November 2026 is the last thirty days and the all-time total. There is no subscription count in the sync. The listing's own user count, about twelve hundred people, is not the same as a payment-company subscriber line. Twelve times the last thirty days is a bit over ninety thousand. That multiplication is mine, from the synced month, and they did not publish it as a yearly figure. Founded January 2024. The same shelf in the app store is full of one-feature tools. A local parcel rule is the same shape.
